objective: 仅使用Phase41的75个development_train画像选择并训练Qwen3-8B纯PD H0+DNN residual预测器，在19个development_validation画像上一次性报告开发集表现，并在blind target不存在的状态下冻结12个blind预测

execution.environment: local CPU clean Git worktree without protected data mounted

dataset.selection_rule: candidate selection uses deterministic five-fold out-of-fold predictions within the 75 development_train profiles only
dataset.validation_rule: the 19 development_validation profiles are evaluated once after candidate selection and cannot alter the selected candidate or final ensemble
dataset.blind_rule: the 12 blind rows provide only feature_* and h0_* inputs; predictions are committed before any blind complete request or Hfull target is opened

predictor.input: non-constant numeric feature_* columns plus log1p(h0 12-bin calls and logical bytes), standardized using development_train only
predictor.target_encoding: log1p(Hfull 12-bin histogram)-log1p(H0 12-bin histogram), independently for calls and logical bytes
predictor.output: nonnegative topology-independent 12-bin calls and logical bytes per 1000 requests
predictor.candidate_score: mean of DNN/H0 ratios for calls_histogram_wape, bytes_histogram_wape, mean_calls_histogram_tv and mean_normalized_log_payload_emd on 75-profile OOF predictions
predictor.final_epochs: median selected-candidate fold best_epoch, clamped to [100,max_epochs]
predictor.checkpoint_format: gzip JSON with preprocessing, selected contract and three NumPy MLP parameter sets

scientific_outcome.improves_composite: validation composite_ratio < 1.0 and neither calls nor bytes histogram WAPE exceeds 1.25x H0
scientific_outcome.negative_result_policy: a development non-improvement is reported, not hidden; blind predictions remain frozen and Phase43 still evaluates them once
scientific_outcome.workflow_pass_meaning: asset isolation, deterministic training, frozen predictions and metric integrity passed; PASS does not itself assert predictor improvement

stop_and_block_if: HEAD is not exact W42, tracked files are dirty, or any untracked file such as protected data is visible in the execution worktree
a pinned Phase41 asset or its manifest differs
the process would access data/, raw traces, complete requests, GPU, network, validation targets during candidate selection, or any blind target
the 75/19/12 split, predictor schema, deterministic repeat check or output manifest differs
a checkpoint or prediction contains target_* or residual_* fields for a blind profile
claim_boundary: Phase42 trains and freezes one Qwen3-8B pure-PD low-dimensional H0+DNN residual predictor
Phase42 development metrics are not blind generalization evidence
Phase42 does not generate or inspect blind targets, run SGLang, use GPU, test the other five models, measure physical RDMA time or make placement claims
